lines.text: CREATIVE AND FINE ARTS REQUIREMENT (AREA VI)
- Art of the American Southwest 3 credit hour(s)
- Music Appreciation: Western Music 3 credit hour(s)
Mesalands Community College is authorized by the New Mexico Higher Education Department to offer programs
leading to Associate of Arts and Associate of Applied Science degrees.
The College also offers programming that leads to certificates. The educational goals emphasize preparing students
